headline: Stop gaining. Start losing. Today decides the next ten months.
summary: You're gaining 0.20 kg/week when you need to lose 0.77 kg/week—a 0.97 kg deficit that TODAY's choices can begin to close.
details: Eat only Huel and whole plant foods today; no emotional snacking, no extras. Log it. Hit the rowing machine or treadmill for 45 minutes this evening—build the calorie deficit NOW.
